description: Across all nine pages of server/8.0/learn/services-and-indexes there is not one mention of RBAC, roles, privileges or permissions - not on the service overview, not on any of the seven per-service pages, and not on the index pages. A reader learning what the Backup Service is is never told that scheduling a backup needs a privilege, and the Index Service page describes creating indexes without naming who may. Prior rounds found the mirror-image gap in the reference tree (statement pages naming a privilege without linking its definition); this is the conceptual tree omitting the axis entirely. Consequence for the ontology: after ~552 records the corpus can say what every service does and nothing about who is allowed to ask it to.
